---
title: "MEPS 2023 Dental Expenditure ZIC-BCF Plan B Analysis"
author: "Eric Wang"
output: html_document
date: "2026-07-01"
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# ============================================================
# MEPS 2023 Dental Expenditure Analysis for ZIC-BCF Plan B
# ============================================================
#
# Purpose:
# This script screens MEPS 2023 expenditure variables for a
# zero-inflated continuous structure, then prepares annual dental
# expenditure as a candidate applied dataset for ZIC-BCF modeling.
#
# Main outcome:
#   y = Annual dental expenditure in 2023 (DVTEXP23)
#
# Exposure:
#   dental_insurance = Any dental insurance coverage in 2023
#
# Notes:
#   - This script assumes that h251.dta, the 2023 MEPS Full-Year
#     Consolidated public-use file, is saved in the working folder.
#   - The raw MEPS file is publicly available from AHRQ.
#   - The baseline hurdle model below uses scaled MEPS person weights
#     for a simple weighted demonstration. It is not intended to be a
#     full complex-survey design analysis.

library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# User settings
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Put h251.dta in this folder, or change this path.
meps_dir <- getwd()

raw_file <- file.path(meps_dir, "h251.dta")

out_dir <- file.path(meps_dir, "MEPS_ZICBCF_planB_outputs")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Load MEPS 2023 Full-Year Consolidated file
# ------------------------------------------------------------

meps <- read_dta(raw_file)


# ============================================================
# 1. Screen candidate zero-inflated continuous expenditure outcomes
# ============================================================

candidate_outcomes <- c(
  "DVTEXP23",  # dental expenditures
  "VISEXP23",  # vision expenditures
  "RXEXP23",   # prescription drug expenditures
  "OPTEXP23",  # outpatient expenditures
  "ERTEXP23",  # emergency room expenditures
  "IPTEXP23",  # inpatient expenditures
  "OTHEXP23",  # other medical expenditures
  "TOTEXP23"   # total medical expenditures
)

outcome_labels <- c(
  DVTEXP23  = "Dental expenditures",
  VISEXP23  = "Vision expenditures",
  RXEXP23   = "Prescription drug expenditures",
  OPTEXP23  = "Outpatient expenditures",
  ERTEXP23  = "Emergency room expenditures",
  IPTEXP23  = "Inpatient expenditures",
  OTHEXP23  = "Other medical expenditures",
  TOTEXP23  = "Total medical expenditures"
)

candidate_comparison <- lapply(candidate_outcomes, function(v) {
  x <- meps[[v]]
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x >= 0]
  x_pos <- x[x > 0]

  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    outcome_label = outcome_labels[[v]],
    n_total = length(x),
    n_zero = sum(x == 0),
    pct_zero = round(100 * mean(x == 0), 2),
    n_positive = length(x_pos),
    mean_positive = round(mean(x_pos), 2),
    median_positive = round(median(x_pos), 2),
    p90_positive = round(quantile(x_pos, 0.90), 2),
    p95_positive = round(quantile(x_pos, 0.95), 2),
    max_positive = max(x_pos)
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_zero))

print(candidate_comparison)

write_csv(
  candidate_comparison,
  file.path(out_dir, "01_MEPS_candidate_outcome_comparison.csv")
)



# ============================================================
# 2. Prepare dental expenditure analysis dataset
# ============================================================

dental_data <- meps %>%
  transmute(
    id = DUPERSID,

    # Outcome
    y = DVTEXP23,
    any_y = as.integer(DVTEXP23 > 0),

    # Exposure: any dental insurance coverage in 2023
    # MEPS coding:
    #   1 = Yes
    #   2 = No
    dental_insurance_raw = DNTINS23_M23,
    dental_insurance = case_when(
      DNTINS23_M23 == 1 ~ 1,
      DNTINS23_M23 == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Covariates
    age = AGE23X,
    female = case_when(
      SEX == 2 ~ 1,
      SEX == 1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    race_ethnicity = factor(RACETHX),
    education_years = ifelse(EDUCYR >= 0, EDUCYR, NA),
    poverty_category = factor(POVCAT23),
    general_health = factor(ifelse(RTHLTH31 > 0, RTHLTH31, NA)),

    cancer_dx = case_when(
      CANCERDX == 1 ~ 1,
      CANCERDX == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # MEPS survey variables
    person_weight = PERWT23F,
    varstr = VARSTR,
    varpsu = VARPSU
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(y),
    y >= 0,
    !is.na(any_y),
    !is.na(dental_insurance),
    !is.na(age),
    !is.na(female),
    !is.na(race_ethnicity),
    !is.na(education_years),
    !is.na(poverty_category),
    !is.na(general_health),
    person_weight > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Scaled weights for model stability
    weight_scaled = person_weight / mean(person_weight, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

write_csv(
  dental_data,
  file.path(out_dir, "meps_2023_dental_hurdle_model_data.csv")
)


# ============================================================
# 3. Summarize zero-inflated dental expenditure structure
# ============================================================

dental_summary <- dental_data %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_zero = sum(y == 0),
    pct_zero = round(100 * mean(y == 0), 2),
    n_positive = sum(y > 0),
    mean_positive = round(mean(y[y > 0]), 2),
    median_positive = round(median(y[y > 0]), 2),
    p90_positive = round(quantile(y[y > 0], 0.90), 2),
    p95_positive = round(quantile(y[y > 0], 0.95), 2),
    max_positive = max(y)
  )

print(dental_summary)

write_csv(
  dental_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "02_MEPS_dental_hurdle_summary.csv")
)


# ============================================================
# 4. Descriptive plots
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 1: zero vs positive dental expenditure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

zero_plot_data <- dental_data %>%
  mutate(
    expenditure_group = ifelse(
      y == 0,
      "Zero dental expenditure",
      "Positive dental expenditure"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(expenditure_group) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
    label = paste0(n, " (", percent, "%)")
  )

p_zero <- ggplot(zero_plot_data, aes(x = expenditure_group, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.4, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Zero vs Positive Annual Dental Expenditures, MEPS 2023",
    x = "",
    y = "Number of participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "06_MEPS_dental_zero_vs_positive.png"),
  plot = p_zero,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

p_zero

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 2: positive dental expenditures on log scale
# ------------------------------------------------------------

positive_dental <- dental_data %>%
  filter(y > 0)

p_positive <- ggplot(positive_dental, aes(x = y)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Positive Annual Dental Expenditures, MEPS 2023",
    x = "Dental expenditure, log10 scale",
    y = "Number of participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "07_MEPS_positive_dental_expenditure_log_histogram.png"),
  plot = p_positive,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

p_positive

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 3: positive dental expenditure by dental insurance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

positive_dental_plot <- positive_dental %>%
  mutate(
    dental_insurance_label = ifelse(
      dental_insurance == 1,
      "Dental insurance",
      "No dental insurance"
    )
  )

p_by_ins <- ggplot(
  positive_dental_plot,
  aes(x = dental_insurance_label, y = y)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Positive Dental Expenditures by Dental Insurance Status",
    x = "",
    y = "Dental expenditure, log10 scale"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "08_MEPS_positive_dental_expenditure_by_insurance.png"),
  plot = p_by_ins,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

p_by_ins

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 4: percent with any dental spending by dental insurance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

any_spending_by_ins <- dental_data %>%
  mutate(
    dental_insurance_label = ifelse(
      dental_insurance == 1,
      "Dental insurance",
      "No dental insurance"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(dental_insurance_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pct_any_spending = 100 * mean(any_y == 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(round(pct_any_spending, 1), "%")
  )

p_any_by_ins <- ggplot(
  any_spending_by_ins,
  aes(x = dental_insurance_label, y = pct_any_spending)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.4, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Percent with Any Dental Expenditure by Dental Insurance Status",
    x = "",
    y = "Percent with any dental expenditure"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "09_MEPS_any_dental_expenditure_by_insurance.png"),
  plot = p_any_by_ins,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

p_any_by_ins


# ============================================================
# 5. Baseline Gamma hurdle model
# ============================================================
#
# Part 1:
#   Logistic regression for any dental expenditure
#
# Part 2:
#   Gamma regression with log link among participants with
#   positive dental expenditure
#
# This baseline model is included as a simple parametric comparison
# for the proposed ZIC-BCF model.

zero_part_model <- glm(
  any_y ~ dental_insurance + age + female + race_ethnicity +
    education_years + poverty_category + general_health + cancer_dx,
  data = dental_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  weights = weight_scaled
)

positive_part_model <- glm(
  y ~ dental_insurance + age + female + race_ethnicity +
    education_years + poverty_category + general_health + cancer_dx,
  data = positive_dental,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  weights = weight_scaled
)

zero_part_results <- tidy(
  zero_part_model,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
)

positive_part_results <- tidy(
  positive_part_model,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
)

write_csv(
  zero_part_results,
  file.path(out_dir, "04_MEPS_dental_logistic_part_full_results.csv")
)

write_csv(
  positive_part_results,
  file.path(out_dir, "05_MEPS_dental_gamma_part_full_results.csv")
)

print(zero_part_results)
print(positive_part_results)


# ============================================================
# 6. Extract dental insurance effect from hurdle model
# ============================================================

logistic_dental_effect <- zero_part_results %>%
  filter(term == "dental_insurance") %>%
  mutate(
    model_part = "Logistic part: any dental expenditure",
    effect_interpretation = "Odds ratio for having any dental expenditure"
  ) %>%
  select(
    model_part,
    term,
    estimate,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    p.value,
    effect_interpretation
  )

gamma_dental_effect <- positive_part_results %>%
  filter(term == "dental_insurance") %>%
  mutate(
    model_part = "Gamma part: positive dental expenditure amount",
    effect_interpretation = "Multiplicative ratio among participants with positive dental expenditure"
  ) %>%
  select(
    model_part,
    term,
    estimate,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    p.value,
    effect_interpretation
  )

main_effect_summary <- bind_rows(
  logistic_dental_effect,
  gamma_dental_effect
) %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    conf.low = round(conf.low, 3),
    conf.high = round(conf.high, 3),
    p.value = signif(p.value, 3)
  )

print(main_effect_summary)

write_csv(
  main_effect_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "03_MEPS_dental_insurance_hurdle_effect_summary.csv")
)



# ============================================================
# 7. Short text summary for email or notes
# ============================================================

summary_text <- c(
  "MEPS 2023 dental expenditure Plan B dataset summary",
  "",
  paste0("Cleaned analysis N: ", dental_summary$n),
  paste0("Zero dental expenditure N: ", dental_summary$n_zero),
  paste0("Positive dental expenditure N: ", dental_summary$n_positive),
  paste0("Percent zero: ", dental_summary$pct_zero, "%"),
  paste0("Median positive dental expenditure: $", dental_summary$median_positive),
  paste0("90th percentile positive dental expenditure: $", dental_summary$p90_positive),
  paste0("95th percentile positive dental expenditure: $", dental_summary$p95_positive),
  paste0("Maximum positive dental expenditure: $", dental_summary$max_positive),
  "",
  "Baseline Gamma hurdle model:",
  paste0(
    "Dental insurance effect on any dental expenditure: OR = ",
    main_effect_summary$estimate[1],
    " (95% CI ",
    main_effect_summary$conf.low[1],
    " to ",
    main_effect_summary$conf.high[1],
    ")."
  ),
  paste0(
    "Dental insurance effect among participants with positive dental expenditure: ratio = ",
    main_effect_summary$estimate[2],
    " (95% CI ",
    main_effect_summary$conf.low[2],
    " to ",
    main_effect_summary$conf.high[2],
    ")."
  )
)

writeLines(
  summary_text,
  file.path(out_dir, "10_MEPS_planB_short_summary.txt")
)

cat("\nDone. Final outputs saved to:\n")
cat(out_dir, "\n")

```
